title: Piercing Frame Solo #171 (임산부 허리 컷 · P50 정의형 · 임산부 · 공예 Norwegian rosemaling folk painting · 체형 임산부브라질부티글램 · 메이크업 GermanGlam · 금속 황동)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her pregnant belly, the frame cutting off beneath the belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult German woman — fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, cool ash-brown hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. Her neck, the hollows above her collarbones and the tops of her shoulders carry the same real living skin as her face: visible pores and fine skin grain, a soft sheen of natural skin oils on the highest planes, faint fine peach-fuzz hairs catching the rim light along the neck and shoulder line, gentle tonal variation with a natural warm flush at the base of the neck and across the collarbones, and the fine natural creases of a real neck — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic.

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick antique-brass septum ring with a smaller antique-brass ring above it and two antique-brass rings through each nostril; a straight antique-brass bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick antique-brass bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a antique-brass Medusa stud above the lips; a big antique-brass hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a antique-brass labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small antique-brass studs along each jaw; a curved row of small antique-brass studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized antique-brass hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine antique-brass chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. All jewelry is real antique brass, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her hips and rear so wide. A high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly projects forward prominently from her front, while behind it a rear so massively rounded and projecting dominates from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape, echoing the belly's own roundness from the opposite side. A full round bust above the belly, gigantic thick thighs. Her head looks small on top of her body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with acanthus scrollwork filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. The bands of the pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it is the body treatment described above.

Pose: standing tall, one hand cradling the underside of her belly and the other relaxed at her side, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
